verdict.rationale: Segment documents Data Storage Destinations that send your raw event data to data warehouses, AWS S3, and Google Cloud Storage. It also offers a Profile API that reads full user and account objects (external_ids, traits, events) and a Public API with a downloadable OpenAPI spec for reading workspace resources. Together these give real routes to pull data out, but none is framed as a complete export-and-leave path, and the export file formats are never specified. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk export or offboarding feature, named open file formats (e.g. JSON/Parquet/CSV) for exports, bulk export of identity graphs, audiences and computed traits, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a full data exit.
